Slow on a CPU, seconds on a GPU; quality is a setting, never a consequence. Settings → Tools installs and connects it; Illustrate, Upscale, Cut out, Variations and Describe run on it.

applications.name: This machine

applications.name: WhatsApp
applications.description: Business messaging through Meta's official Cloud API, or a personal account through a self-hosted bridge.

mechanisms.label: WhatsApp Business (Cloud API)
mechanisms.warning: Needs a Meta Business account and a dedicated number. Incoming messages need the gateway's public address (ADR-032 step 10).

mechanisms.label: Personal account (self-hosted bridge)
mechanisms.warning: Links as a WhatsApp Web device over the unofficial protocol. Against WhatsApp's terms; Meta bans accounts it detects automating. Use a secondary number if you can. Runs only on this machine — never through a third party.
